label: legend_0120_mastiff_01
text: Wuff!

label: legend_0120_friend_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]All right! You ready for a battle,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_02
text: You come up to me just to tell me no? C’mon,\nlittle bud—don’t mess with me like that![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_03
text: Excellent! You’re ready too, right, Mabosstiff?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_04
text: Bu-wuff! Wuff!

label: legend_0120_friend_05
text: Yep, Mabosstiff says he’s ready![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_select_01
text: You’re battling with Mabosstiff?!

label: legend_0120_select_02
text: Wait, are you sure about this?!

label: legend_0120_friend_06
text: OK, yeah, I can see why you’d be worried...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_07
text: But my buddy here’s bursting with energy! You’d\nnever know he was so weak just a little while ago![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_08
text: Won’t leave me alone—always whining at me,\nwanting to battle you and your Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_09
text:
It’s been so long I nearly forgot, but he always
did love to battle.\c
Even if we always lost to that student council
girl—the battle fanatic one.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_10
text: Anyway, my point is there’s no need to worry![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_11
text: We’re a brand-new Arven and Mabosstiff! And\nwe’re feeling audacious—or maybe herbaceous?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_12
text: Let me give you a taste of what we can do![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_13
text: Dang... This is the strength of someone who\ncould take down those Titan Pokémon, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_14
text: Yeah, much as I hate to admit it...I do think we’re\ngonna need some more support.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_15
text: The Pokémon in Area Zero are super strong, and\nthere are all sorts of weird machines there, too.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_16
text: I’d say we need at least two more people...\nSomebody with some [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Champion Rank–level skills[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\r\nand somebody who can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]deal with crazy tech[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_select_03
text: That sounds like Nemona!

label: legend_0120_select_04
text: That sounds like Penny!

label: legend_0120_select_05
text: Maybe...Nemona?

label: legend_0120_select_06
text: Maybe...Penny?

label: legend_0120_friend_16a
text: The student council president?\c\nYou’re probably right. That girl can take on any\nPokémon that comes at her. She’s a beast![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_16b
text:
Penny? That crazy-smart hacker girl who was
the big boss behind Team Star?\c
I mean, yeah, she’d be perfect for the job...
But when did you go making friends with some
shady character like her?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_16c
text:
The student council girl?\c
Yeah, she’d be perfect for the job, but I doubt
she’d give us the time of day unless one of us
was on her level. As in Champion Rank level.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_16d
text:
Huh? Never knew we had someone all tech savvy
like that at school.\c
But I doubt someone with those skills would
bother helping us out unless she owed us...
or at least liked us.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_17a
text: But, well, we’ve gotta do what we’ve gotta do!\c\nWhoever you think could be a help, just try\ngetting in good with ’em![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_18a
text: We’ll see if we can’t get a team together. Get in\ntouch if you make progress—I’ll do the same![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_17b
text: Huh! Well, seems like you’ve been busy making\nsome pretty useful friends![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: legend_0120_friend_18b
text:
I’ll reach out to them and organize things. You
just make sure you’re there.\c
The meeting place will be the Zero Gate. It’s this
facility out on the edge of the Great Crater.\c
I’ll send you the info on how to find it, so don’t
keep us waiting forever![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
